minor.issue: Returns 406 Not Acceptable intermittently on project detail load (single object select). Non-blocking, page still renders because .maybeSingle() is used, but shows up as HTTP error in DevTools.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking 'Attach proof (PDF or image)' and selecting a file does NOT submit the proof on web. DocumentPicker fires change event, no submit-payment-proof network request follows, status remains COMMITTED. RCA: `invokeSubmitPaymentProof` in /app/src/services/edgeFunctions.services.ts builds FormData with `{ uri, name, type }` cast to Blob (React-Native-only pattern). On web the DocumentPicker returns `asset.file` (a real File object), which is never used, so the FormData assembly fails silently or produces an unusable body. Recommend: on web (Platform.OS === 'web'), read `asset.file` directly and append it as the Blob to FormData, e.g. `formData.append('file', asset.file, asset.name)`.
Realised profit is only shown in the aggregate stat grid, not on the individual holding card. Might mislead investors who look at a single holding. Not blocking.

action_items: Fix `invokeSubmitPaymentProof` so it uses asset.file (real File object) on web instead of the RN {uri,name,type} blob shim. This is the root cause blocking the Payment-proof upload from the UI.
Optional: expose per-holding realised profit on the Portfolio card for clarity.

In useSubmitPaymentProof.ts, mutation errors should surface a toast/alert; currently a silent failure leaves the user with no feedback (see current UX: user picks a file, nothing happens, button still says Attach proof).
Home projections aggregate uses ROI from every invitation regardless of status; leftover invitations from earlier iterations skew totals (₦1.9K includes a not-yet-committed Mine invitation).

rca of the issue: Attach-proof bug: On web, DocumentPicker.getDocumentAsync returns assets with a `file: File` field (real File object). But invokeSubmitPaymentProof constructs `formData.append('file', { uri, name, type } as unknown as Blob, fileName)`. The plain object is not a Blob/File on web, so FormData.append either stringifies it or silently rejects it, and the resulting fetch never reaches the edge function (no submit-payment-proof request observed in network). Confirmed by (a) intercepting fetch globally and seeing zero calls after change fires, and (b) manually calling the same edge function with a real File blob from JS -> returned 200 and status flipped to PROOF_SUBMITTED. Fix: on Platform.OS==='web', use asset.file directly. Reproduction: Sign in as investor, open the project on Payment tab, click 'Attach proof', pick any file. Expected: submit-payment-proof POST + status flip to PROOF_SUBMITTED. Actual: nothing happens visually or in network.
